🚨 *new alert — needs human* (15th cluster of B011R3D650X frontend-errors flap)
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  •  confidence: 0.60  •  bug-type guess: unknown  •  alerts in group: 2

Symptoms:
  - Two empty-text alerts from Datadog monitor bot `B011R3D650X` in `alert-frontend-errors`, 4m01s apart (10:32:12Z and 10:36:13Z).
  - 15th cluster of the same monitor+channel+empty-text shape since 2026-05-13T19:14Z. Prior cluster (`cc184c0d33f2d8b6`) tail was 2026-05-14T21:04:12Z — the flap quieted overnight for ~13h28m, then resumed.
  - Cron has been silent since 2026-05-14T22:13Z (~13h gap). Heartbeat at 2026-05-15T10:46:56Z flagged 5 alerts unlogged in the prior 6h; only these 2 fall inside the current 65-min poll window, so the other 3 (alert-system×2, alert-runtime-monitoring×1) remain permanently unlogged for this cycle.

Trace IDs: none — alert text is empty (Slack-blocks-only payload), and the monitor IDs aren't surfaced in `conversations.history` without DD API access.
Likely cause: same as last 14 clusters — a Datadog frontend-errors monitor on `B011R3D650X` is in a sustained alert/no-data flap. Root cause is undiagnosable from Slack alone; the 13h overnight lull is informative but uninterpretable without DD/ES.

Suggested next action: 1 of these 3 is still the only path forward:
  1. Open DD and identify monitor `B011R3D650X` posts into `#alert-frontend-errors`; mute or retune it.
  2. Provision `DD_API_KEY`/`DD_APP_KEY` (and ELK creds, SSH bastion) into the routine env so the bot can actually investigate.
  3. Flip `kb/config.json.enabled` to `false` until either of the above is done, to stop accumulating zero-information `needs-human` clusters.

Also worth flagging: the routine cron itself has been silent for ~13h (last successful poll-cycle 2026-05-14T22:13Z, this is a manual local run). The heartbeat is firing degraded warnings but the cron is not picking up. Worth checking why scheduled triage routine isn't firing.

🚨 *new alert — needs human* (cluster #16 of B011R3D650X frontend-errors flap)
Channel: alert-frontend-errors  •  confidence: 0.60  •  bug-type guess: unknown (env: 11th cycle no DD/ES)  •  alerts in group: 2

Symptoms:
  - Same fingerprint as clusters 1–15: bot `B011R3D650X` + alert-frontend-errors + empty text body
  - 2 fires, 4m59s apart (11:33:13Z, 11:38:12Z) — typical inter-fire spacing for this flap
  - 57m00s gap from cluster 15 tail (10:36:13Z) → past 30-min window so distinct group

Trace IDs: n/a (alert text is empty — DD content in Slack blocks)

Likely cause: same as the prior 15 — a Datadog frontend-errors monitor routed through bot `B011R3D650X` in a sustained alert/no-data flap. Cannot identify monitor without DD API.

⚠️ *New signal this cycle:* same bot `B011R3D650X` ALSO fired on `#alert-system` 3m31s after this cluster's tail (Group B, separate DM). First time alert-system has co-fired with this flap. May indicate the underlying issue is widening from a single monitor into a sibling — or two unrelated monitors flapping by coincidence. If next cycle repeats the pair, treat as cross-channel escalation.

Suggested next action: *check DD UI now*. Look at frontend-errors monitor owned by B011R3D650X **and** any alert-system monitor it owns — they may share an upstream metric. If still noisy, mute or retune.

🚨 *new alert — needs human* (B011R3D650X fires on alert-system — first time within recent flap window)
Channel: alert-system  •  confidence: 0.55  •  bug-type guess: unknown (env: 11th cycle no DD/ES)  •  alerts in group: 2

Symptoms:
  - Bot `B011R3D650X` posting on `#alert-system` — empty text, DD block content invisible
  - 2 fires, 4m53s apart (11:41:43Z, 11:46:36Z)
  - Started 3m31s after Group A (frontend-errors cluster #16) tail at 11:38:12Z — *same bot, same poll cycle*
  - No Centreon (B03GBAMHUTB) or B05PN7JG87L co-firing this cycle — narrower than the May 14 P0-correlated 40-alert flurry
  - swat empty — no user-impact signal

Trace IDs: n/a (alert text empty)

Likely cause: two competing hypotheses, no DD to resolve:
  1. *Escalation* — same frontend monitor's underlying metric is breaching a sibling alert-system threshold owned by B011R3D650X. Timing (3m31s lag) is consistent with a slower sliding-window threshold catching up to the faster frontend-errors monitor.
  2. *Coincidence* — two unrelated B011R3D650X monitors flapping concurrently. Less plausible given timing tightness vs. base rate of alert-system fires (last B011R3D650X-on-alert-system primary was 2026-05-14T12:08Z, part of the swat P0).

Suggested next action: when checking DD UI for the flap monitor, also list all monitors owned by B011R3D650X with `alert-system` channel routing — if you find a paired/sibling monitor on the same metric, that's the cross-channel escalation. If next cycle repeats the pair, escalate.
